doubts: The page presents the Wharfedale Track (View Hill car park to Wharfedale Hut) and the Townshend Track (Wharfedale Hut out to Lees Valley Road) as sections; the main way is taken as the full crossing named in the title, with DOC's 1–2 days. The text does not say whether people return the same way or arrange transport. View Hill car park is taken as F1 (Wharfedale Track meeting the road also called Wharfedale Track at the start of the track); the gazetteer 'View Hill' place (T8) is several km away and not used. The Lees Valley Road end has no entry. The Fosters Ridge Track junction is mentioned only for a slip between it and Wharfedale Hut; whether it lies on this way is unclear.
